name: Rocket Blast - 1g Cart - Pie'd Up
description:
Sweet, warm, and dessert-rich. The Rocket Blast Pie'd Up cartridge holds 1 gram of premium oil — a distillate base blended with terpenes — in a universal-fit 510-thread cart that screws right onto any standard battery. Simple, reliable, and made to last.

Pie'd Up delivers a bakery-fresh flavor: sweet baked fruit and buttery pie-crust notes with a smooth, sugary finish. It's an indulgent, dessert-forward profile made for anyone who likes their sessions rich, sweet, and full of flavor.

Why you'll love it:

1G total oil — premium distillate blended with terpenes for full flavor
Universal 510-thread fit — works with any standard 510 battery
Signature Pie'd Up flavor — sweet baked fruit with buttery pie-crust notes
Reliable performance — flavorful, even pulls from first to last

Rich flavor and dependable quality in a classic, easy-to-use cartridge. Just attach your battery and enjoy — Rocket Blast Pie'd Up is ready when you are.

For adult use only. Must be 21+. Keep out of reach of children and pets.
